why: The student reads e in 6.02e23 as Euler's number, which is the documented misconception ExponentIsPower; in Java the literal means 6.02 x 10^23.

concepts.quote: 6.02e23 is 6.02 times e to the power 23.
concepts.why: In a Java literal, e means times ten to the power, so 6.02e23 is 6.02 x 10^23, not 6.02 x e^23.
